notes.title: Lesson Learned full version premiere
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836807/8d0c8baf0b47dc96251db2a04ee85d60bfb0fec4.png[/img]

It’s me, Amelia! The day we've all been waiting for has arrived. What we learned together in the prologue, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url] will be tested today. Let's start a historical eras exam. 

[h3]The full version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url] is now available on [b]Steam[/b] with a [b]-25%[/b] discount and on Xbox! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/

My best friend Frank fell asleep in history class and found himself in a bizarre dream world. He often failed to pay attention in school, but he had never yet had to defend himself from an attack by Roman legionaries because of it! 

To get out, you'll have to work together to guide our base, Gervase, through prehistory, antiquity and even the French Revolutionary era. See for yourself who you will have to face on various levels:

[previewyoutube=0trRota7UbI;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Frank and help him find the rest of his classmates. A journey through historical eras is a real group project, so cooperation will be important. You, too, can invite your friends and go through the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url] campaign in split-screen [i]cooperative mode[/i].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url], is a tower defense game. You will obtain different types of towers, learn how to distribute tasks, and fend off the attacks of various enemies. Everyone has their own weaknesses, for example Mikey can’t resist donuts, and our enemies will be defeated by fire or spikes. If you want to practice the game's mechanics, join me in playing the free prologue, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url], which is now available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/

Frank is waiting for our help already on the first level, so let's get started! If you have any questions, drop by the class [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url].

Good luck!
Amelia & Gaming Factory

[url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836807/2ffe4f29c78b5574e52351a57356e169eaec4047.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Full version of Lesson Learned coming in May
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35377707/f430b8fe4c6bbd6bc98de34971ea0db46baab19d.png[/img]

Great news for every fan of tower defense games! The full version of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]Lesson Learned[/url][/b] will be available on [b]May 29, 2024[/b], on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Xbox[/b]!

[b]Watch the teaser announcing the date of Lesson Learned:[/b]

https://youtu.be/RC2FGmXwU6E
In this hilarious tower defense game, Frank and a campaign led through different historical eras await you. Defend your mobile base with a succession of defense towers and distribute tasks among the minions - Frank's classmates.

You can play [b]Lesson Learned[/b] in solo or cooperative mode. Invite friends and try your hand at split-screen campaign mode.

Play the free prologue [b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b], which is now available. In it, you will learn the necessary mechanics and face the bloody Countess Elizabeth Batory. Also add [b]Lesson Learned[/b] to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/
